name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year per eligible farmer family, paid in 3 instalments of Rs 2,000 every 4 months by Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: Landholding farmer families (husband, wife and minor children) with cultivable land in their name as per land records.
exclusions: Institutional landholders; present/former holders of constitutional posts, ministers, MPs, MLAs; serving or retired officers (except MTS/Class IV/Group D); pensioners with Rs 10,000+ per month; income tax payers in the last assessment year; registered professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, architects).
documents: Aadhaar, land ownership records, bank account (Aadhaar-seeded), mobile number, eKYC.
apply: Self-register at pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner) or through a Common Service Centre (CSC) or state nodal officer. Complete eKYC.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefits: Health cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for cashless secondary and tertiary hospital care at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Families identified through SECC 2011 deprivation/occupation criteria (rural and urban categories) and added state lists. Senior citizens aged 70+ are also covered under the Vay Vandana extension regardless of income (verify current rules).
exclusions: Families not in the eligibility database (except 70+ extension). Check 'Am I Eligible' on the portal.
documents: Aadhaar, ration card or other ID, mobile number; family details for e-KYC.
apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555. Get the Ayushman card made at an empanelled hospital, CSC or Ayushman Mitra.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (via National Scholarship Portal)
benefits: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of compulsory fees for SC students studying after Class 10 (amounts depend on course group).
eligibility: Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matric/post-secondary courses; family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh per annum (verify current ceiling).
exclusions: Students above the income limit; students not enrolled in recognised institutions. Other NSP scholarships (minority, OBC, ST) have different income limits and marks criteria.
documents: Aadhaar, caste certificate, income certificate, previous marksheet, admission/fee receipt, bank account passbook.
apply: Register and apply online at scholarships.gov.in during the open window; institute and state verification follows.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
benefits: Free LPG connection (deposit-free) for eligible women; targeted subsidy on refills (amount revised periodically, e.g. Rs 300 per 14.2 kg cylinder in recent years - verify).
eligibility: Adult woman from a poor/BPL household (SECC or listed categories such as SC/ST, PMAY-G, AAY, tea garden workers) with no existing LPG connection in the household.
exclusions: Households that already have an LPG connection.
documents: KYC (Aadhaar), ration card / BPL proof, bank account details, passport-size photo, address proof.
apply: Submit the KYC form at a nearby LPG distributor or apply on the pmuy.gov.in portal.

name: PM Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
benefits: Financial assistance for a pucca house with basic amenities: Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas, plus convergence benefits (toilet, MGNREGA wages, etc.).
eligibility: Rural households that are houseless or live in kutcha/dilapidated houses, identified from SECC data and Awaas+ survey.
exclusions: Households owning a pucca house, motorised vehicle, or meeting other prescribed exclusion criteria.
documents: Aadhaar, job card (if any), bank account details, SBM toilet details, beneficiary list verification.
apply: Beneficiaries are selected from the Gram Sabha-verified list; contact Gram Panchayat / Block office. Check at pmayg.nic.in.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60, depending on the contribution and joining age.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank account and mobile number.
exclusions: Income tax payers are not eligible to join (rule in force since October 2022).
documents: Aadhaar (or other ID), savings bank account, mobile number, nominee details.
apply: Open through your bank branch or net banking; auto-debit of contribution from the bank account.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
benefits: Small-savings account for a girl child: minimum Rs 250 and maximum Rs 1.5 lakh deposit per year; interest rate set by the government each quarter; tax benefit under Section 80C (old regime); matures after 21 years.
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age; account opened by parent/legal guardian; one account per girl child (limit of two girls per family, with exceptions for twins/triplets).
exclusions: Girls aged 10 or above at the time of opening; more than one account per girl.
documents: Girl's birth certificate, parent/guardian ID and address proof, initial deposit.
apply: Open at any post office or authorised bank branch.

name: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
benefits: Collateral-free business loans: Shishu up to Rs 50,000; Kishor Rs 50,001 to 5 lakh; Tarun Rs 5 lakh to 10 lakh (Tarun Plus limit raised to Rs 20 lakh for eligible past borrowers per Budget 2024 - verify).
eligibility: Indian citizens with a business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity (manufacturing, trading, services) of micro/small scale.
exclusions: Agricultural activities (crop farming) are generally outside the scope.
documents: ID and address proof, business plan/proof of business, bank statements, photographs, caste certificate if applicable.
apply: Apply at banks, NBFC-MFIs, or via the Udyami Mitra portal.

name: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
dept: Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Karnataka
benefits: Rs 2,000 per month paid to the woman head of the family by DBT.
eligibility: Woman head of the family holding a BPL, APL or Antyodaya ration card in Karnataka.
exclusions: Families where the head of the family (or spouse) is an income tax or GST payer.
documents: Ration card, Aadhaar, bank account (Aadhaar-seeded), mobile number.
apply: Apply on the Seva Sindhu portal or at Grama One / Bangalore One / Karnataka One centres.

name: Anna Bhagya (Karnataka)
dept: Dept of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Govt of Karnataka
benefits: Food grains for BPL/Antyodaya ration card holders under NFSA (5 kg per member) plus additional support in lieu of extra grain (mode and rate has changed over time - verify current).
eligibility: Families holding a BPL (priority household) or Antyodaya (AAY) ration card in Karnataka.
exclusions: APL card holders (not covered by this benefit).
documents: BPL/AAY ration card, Aadhaar, bank account (for DBT).
apply: Benefit is through the ration card; apply for or correct a ration card on the Ahara / Seva Sindhu portals.

name: Gruha Jyothi (Karnataka)
benefits: Up to 200 units of free electricity per month for domestic consumers (based on the 12-month average consumption plus 10 percent, capped at 200 units).
eligibility: Domestic electricity consumers in Karnataka (owners and tenants) with a registered ESCOM account.
documents: Electricity account ID, Aadhaar, tenancy agreement (if tenant).
apply: Register on Seva Sindhu with your electricity account ID.

name: Shakti - Free Bus Travel for Women (Karnataka)
benefits: Free travel for women in ordinary state-run (KSRTC/BMTC/NWKRTC/KKRTC) non-luxury buses within Karnataka.
eligibility: Women who are residents of Karnataka; carry a valid Karnataka address ID (Shakti smart card or ID as notified).
documents: Valid government ID with Karnataka address.
apply: Obtain the Shakti smart card from Seva Sindhu / bus-transport offices, or show a valid ID as per current rules.

name: Right to Information Act, 2005 (RTI) - your right
dept: Dept of Personnel & Training / Central Information Commission
benefits: Any citizen can ask a public authority for information; reply due within 30 days (48 hours for life/liberty matters); application fee Rs 10 for central bodies (state fees vary); BPL applicants are exempt from the fee.
exclusions: Information exempt under Section 8 (e.g. national security, personal info with no public interest).
documents: Written/online application; BPL certificate if claiming fee exemption.
apply: File online at rtionline.gov.in (central) or the state RTI portal; first appeal to the First Appellate Authority, then the Information Commission.
